blocks.text: By accessing Zscaler Deception, you provide Zscaler the right to process, use, reproduce, store, modify, and display the information from logs. For Deception, logs are defined as follows:

blocks.item: Security Telemetry Logs: The security telemetry data that is generated based on the interactions between the suspected attackers and the auto-generated decoys.
Audit logs: The activity logs of configuration changes made by you on the Deception Admin Portal.

blocks.text: Logs do not include your internal system logs. Logs are retained by Zscaler for a rolling period of 12 months during the term of subscription. When the subscription term ends or expires, Zscaler deletes the logs within 30 days. If you ordered the Deception log streaming service, then you can stream the logs in real-time to an on-premises solution. The logs can be sent to multiple systems that allow you to retain them for however long you choose.

During the deployment process, you can choose to have your logs stored in the United States, European Union, or Asia Pacific region. If you use GenAI Decoys (Built with Llama), inputs from potential threat actors will be processed in the US region for all customers.
